name: EmojiCut
description: A sticker printer page: cut a sticker sheet into separate transparent PNGs in the browser, or have AI design the sheet with the visitor's own key.

zh.name: EmojiCut 贴纸打印机
zh.description: 一个贴纸打印机页面：在浏览器里把贴纸大图切成单独的透明 PNG，或用访客自己的密钥让 AI 设计整张贴纸。

setupHelp: Enable it to publish /tools/emojicut. Cutting runs entirely in the visitor's browser; AI design uses the visitor's own Gemini API key, kept only in their browser.

page.title: EmojiCut
page.description: Turn a sticker sheet into separate transparent stickers, or design one from a character with AI.

ai.description: Offer AI sticker design with the visitor's own Gemini API key. Cutting works either way.

imageModel.description: Gemini model that designs the sticker sheet (Nano Banana Pro by default). Any image-output model id from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models.

namingModel.description: Fast Gemini model that names each AI-designed sticker for the ZIP.
